Inmate Bardo ADC#900276 refusing to exit cell in 12 Barracks
~7:15am
Bardo barricaded door with mattress, wouldn't respond to orders
Lt Franklin authorized forced cell movement 7:20am
Sgt Whitfield gave 4 direct orders to come out — Bardo refused, said "I'll kill any officer that steps in here"
5-man team assembled: Sgt Whitfield, Cpl Alvarez, Cpl Nguyen, Cpl Castillo, Cpl Boyd
Door breached, Bardo rushed team, swung fist at Cpl Castillo — missed
Bardo taken to ground, cuffed by Cpl Alvarez
Sgt Whitfield video recorded entire extraction on handheld camera
Cpl Castillo placed leg restraints
Bardo escorted to Restrictive Housing by Cpl Alvarez & Cpl Nguyen
No injuries to staff or inmate
Bardo refused medical
Shift Capt Lindholm notified 7:30am
Photos taken of barricaded cell
